column1: # weapons.csv — weapon catalogue. Loaded by WeaponDatabase at scene init.
#   name           — display name (currently unused by UI; text rendering not wired)
#   cooldown       — seconds between fires (ignored for Sustained)
#   lifetime       — seconds before despawn (Fixed/Orbital use this too)
#   level_up_amount — bump per level. Damage/Count add (int part);
#   size           — visual scale (uniform). Collider radius scales
#                     proportionally so larger bullets hit a larger area.
#   acceleration   — speed delta per second. Positive = accelerate
#                     Orbital weapons interpret this as angular rad/sec².
